topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I can't believe this is happening. Everything was set for today, the tickets, the plans, the reservations. Now, as I stand here in the crowded terminal, the announcement echoes that my flight has been delayed—again. The event I've been looking forward to for months, the one that feels like a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, is slipping away. People are shuffling around, some looking as lost as I feel, others with looks of indifference. I try to call, to reschedule, but the lines are busy. I look at my watch, then back at the departure board, the reality sinking in with each passing minute.
